rate_limits.note: Free Meta tier ≈200 Graph calls/hr/user. Comment crawlers defer (not fail) when the SQLite-backed budget is spent.

comments.note: Comment bodies need META_IG_TOKEN (+media_id) / META_FB_PAGE_TOKEN (+post_id). Beyond per_post_cap matches/post/day are stored quietly as digest.

crisis_mode.note: PR-crisis posture: extra complaint keywords ON, alerts ONLY for fresh content. Arm via config, TRACKER_CRISIS=1 env, --crisis flag, or the crisis.yml workflow.

telegram.note: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env vars and flip to true

slack.note: Free: create an Incoming Webhook (api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks), export SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL

teams.note: Free: Power Automate 'When a HTTP request is received' URL, export TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL

email.note: Free SMTP: export SMTP_HOST/SMTP_PORT/SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS/ALERT_EMAIL_TO (+ALERT_EMAIL_FROM). Gmail needs an App Password.
